_comment: OPTIONAL agent-skills lifecycle hooks for Claude Code.
Merge the 'hooks' key into ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope) or
.claude/settings.json (project scope). Do NOT add it in both places, and do
not add it if a plugin already registers the same commands - duplicate
registration makes every hook fire twice.
Replace <AGENT_SKILLS>/ with the path to your agent-skills clone, e.g.
$HOME/work/agent-skills. Hooks cannot expand ${VAR} in every host version,
so an absolute path is the reliable choice.
See hooks/README.md for why these are templates rather than defaults.

hooks.command: bash <AGENT_SKILLS>/scripts/finish-task.sh --skill "${AGENT_SKILLS_ACTIVE_SKILL:-unknown}" --status needs-context --no-cleanup --no-candidates --summary "session ended without an explicit finish-task call" || true
